<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>public</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_vsc.SCSecurityPolicyUtil</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>Util is used for security policies related common functions</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>SCSecurityPolicyUtil</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var SCSecurityPolicyUtil = Class.create();
SCSecurityPolicyUtil.prototype = {
    constants: new sn_vsc.SecurityCenterConstants(),
    initialize: function() {
        this.scRecordsEncodedQuery = "sys_scope=a51d46e3f2014110366b10017c5ba675";
        this.defaultRecordsCountToFetch = 25;
    },
    updateActivityStream: function(record, previous) {
        var tableName = record.getElement("sys_class_name");
        var activityStreamFields = {
            "sn_vsc_security_policy_condition": ["action_type", "action_attributes", "order"],
            "sn_vsc_security_policy_condition_msgs": {
                "action_type": gs.getMessage("Policy condition's action type changed to: \""),
                "action_attributes": gs.getMessage("Policy action attributes changed to: \""),
                "order": gs.getMessage("Policy condition order changed to: \"")
            },
            "sn_vsc_security_policy_action": ["action_type", "action_attributes"],
            "sn_vsc_security_policy_action_msgs": {
                "action_type": gs.getMessage("Policy action type changed to: \""),
                "action_attributes": gs.getMessage("Policy action's action attributes changed to: \"")
            }
        };
        if (activityStreamFields.hasOwnProperty(tableName)) {
            var fields = activityStreamFields[tableName];
            var finalComment = "";
            var gr = new GlideRecord("sn_vsc_security_policy");
            for (var i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) {
                var field = fields[i];
                if (record.getElement(field).changes()) {
                    if (field == "action_attributes") {
                        var attributes = record.action_attributes;
                        for (var variable in attributes) {
                            if (attributes[variable] == previous[field][variable]) {
                                continue;
                            }
                            var label = attributes[variable] == null ? "" : attributes[variable].getLabel();
                            if (label == 'sys_id') {
                                // this is a copy of a condition or action, not an actual update. Do not create a comment
                                return;
                            }
                            var updatedVal = record.getDisplayValue(field + '.' + variable);
                            if (updatedVal == null) {
                                updatedVal = "";
                            }
                            var oldVal = previous.getDisplayValue(field + '.' + variable);
                            if (oldVal == null) {
                                oldVal = "";
                            }
                            finalComment += "Parameter \"" + label + "\"" +
                                " of \"" + record.getDisplayValue('action_type') + "\" has been changed to: \"" +
                                updatedVal + "\" from \"" + oldVal + "\"\n";
                        }
                    } else {
                        finalComment += activityStreamFields[tableName + "_msgs"][field] + record.getDisplayValue(field) +
                            "\" from \"" + previous.getDisplayValue(field) + "\"\n";
                    }
                }
            }
            if (finalComment) {
                finalComment = "SYSTEM GENERATED:\n" + finalComment;
                // Add all the field changes in one go and push it in the comment of the record
                if (gr.get(record.getValue("policy"))) {
                    gr.comment = finalComment;
                    gr.update();
                }
            }
        }
    },

    copyPolicyFromID: function(policyID) {
        var gr = this.getPolicyRecordFromID(policyID);
        if (this.policyIsValid(gr)) {
            return this.copyPolicyFromRecord(gr);
        }
    },

    copyPolicyFromRecord: function(policy) {
        var copiedPolicy = new GlideRecordSecure(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY);
        copiedPolicy.initialize();
        if (!copiedPolicy.canCreate()) {
            gs.warn("User '" + gs.getUserName() + "' attempted to copy a policy, but lacks permissions to do so.");
            return;
        }
        copiedPolicy = new GlideRecord(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY);
        if (!copiedPolicy.get(policy.sys_id)) {
            gs.warn("Failed to get SC Notification Policy " + policy.sys_id + " while attempting to clone it.");
            return;
        }
        copiedPolicy.name = copiedPolicy.name + " - Copy";
        copiedPolicy.status = "inactive";
        copiedPolicy.configured = "not_configured";
        copiedPolicy.policy_type = "custom";
        var copyID = copiedPolicy.insert();
        copiedPolicy.get(copyID);
        this._copyConditions(copiedPolicy, policy);
        this._copyActions(copiedPolicy, policy);
        return copyID;
    },

    getPolicyRecordFromID: function(policyID) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY);
        if (!gr.get(policyID)) {
            gs.warn("Failed to get SC Notification Policy " + policy.sys_id);
            return null;
        }
        return gr;
    },

    policyIsValid: function(policy) {
        if (!policy) {
            gs.warn("Attempted to verify SC Security Notification Policy, but it is undefined or null");
            return false;
        }
        if (!policy.isValidRecord()) {
            gs.warn("Attempted to get SC Security Notification Policy '" + policy.name + "' with id '" + policy.sys_id + "' but this record is invalid.");
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    },

    _copyConditions: function(toPolicy, fromPolicy) {
        this._copyActionsOrConditions(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY_CONDITION, toPolicy, fromPolicy);
    },

    _copyActions: function(toPolicy, fromPolicy) {
        this._copyActionsOrConditions(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY_ACTION, toPolicy, fromPolicy);
    },

    _copyActionsOrConditions: function(table, toPolicy, fromPolicy) {
        var toID = toPolicy.sys_id;
        var fromID = fromPolicy.sys_id;
        var actions = new GlideRecord(table);
        actions.addQuery('policy', fromID);
        actions.query();
        while (actions.next()) {
            var copiedAction = new GlideRecord(table);
            copiedAction.get(actions.sys_id);
            copiedAction.setValue('policy', toID);
            copiedAction.setValue('policy_type', 'custom');
            var copiedID = copiedAction.insert();
            copiedAction.get(copiedID);
            this._copyVariables(copiedAction, actions);
            copiedAction.update();
        }
    },

    _copyVariables: function(toRecord, fromRecord) {
        for (var key in fromRecord.action_attributes) {
            if (fromRecord.action_attributes[key] == null) {
                continue;
            }
            toRecord.action_attributes[key] = fromRecord.action_attributes[key].toString();
        }
    },

    getPolicyStats: function(policyID) {
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY_STATS);
        gr.addQuery('policy', policyID);
        gr.query();
        if (gr.next()) {
            return gr;
        }
        gr = new GlideRecord(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY_STATS);
        gr.initialize();
        gr.setValue('policy', policyID);
        gr.setValue('triggered_count', 0);
        gr.insert();
        return gr;
    },

    incrementTriggeredStats: function(policyID, lastTriggerTime) {
        var gr = this.getPolicyStats(policyID);
        gr.setValue('triggered_count', this.getTriggerCount(policyID));
        gr.setValue('last_triggered', lastTriggerTime);
        gr.update();
    },

    getWeeklyTriggerCount: function(policyID, weeksAgo) {
        weeksAgo = weeksAgo ? weeksAgo : 0;
        var startWindow = new GlideDateTime(gs.beginningOfLastWeek());
        var endWindow = new GlideDateTime(gs.endOfLastWeek());
        startWindow.addDaysUTC(-7 * weeksAgo);
        endWindow.addDaysUTC(-7 * weeksAgo);
        return this.getTriggerCount(policyID, startWindow, endWindow);
    },

    getTriggerCount: function(policyID, start, end) {
        var executions = new GlideAggregate(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY_HISTORY);
        executions.addQuery('policy', policyID);
        if (start != null && start != undefined)
            executions.addQuery('start_time', '>=', start);
        if (end != null && end != undefined)
            executions.addQuery('start_time', '<', end);
        executions.addAggregate('COUNT');
        executions.query();
        executions.next();
        var count = Number(executions.getAggregate('COUNT'));
        return count;
    },

    // Functions "getExistingPolicyConditions" and "getExistingPolicyNotifications" will eventually be merged into common utility in next release
    getExistingPolicyConditions: function(policyID) {
        var resp = {
            "conditions_for_ui": [],
            "existingConditionsOfPolicyIds": []
        };

        // If the role is not admin/sn_vsc.security_center_viewer, we should restrict querying tables
        if (!gs.hasRole(this.constants.SECURITY_CENTER_VIEWER_ROLE)) {
            return resp;
        }

        // Get all the conditions for the policy
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY_CONDITION);
        gr.addQuery("policy", policyID);
        gr.query();
        // Get all the action inputs one by one for the policy condition(s)
        var existingConditionsOfPolicyIds = [];
        while (gr.next()) {
            var policyConditionSysId = gr.getValue("sys_id");
            var attributes = gr.action_attributes;
            var actionType = gr.getValue("action_type");
            var additionalQuery = "model_id=" + actionType;
            var actionInputObj = new GlideRecord("sys_hub_action_input");
            // Limiting only to SC related records so not to query/expose entire table
            actionInputObj.addEncodedQuery(this.scRecordsEncodedQuery);
            if (actionInputObj.get("model_id", actionType)) {
                var attrName = actionInputObj.element;
                var value = attributes[attrName].toString();
                var tableName = actionInputObj.getValue("reference");
                if (tableName) {
                    var sysIds = value.split(",");
                    value = this.createSelectedValuesConfig(tableName, sysIds, attrName.toString(), "sn_vsc_security_policy_condition");
                }
                // Get the condition name and description
                additionalQuery = "sys_id=" + actionType;
                var sysHubActionTypeDefGr = new GlideRecord("sys_hub_action_type_definition");
                // Limiting only to SC related records so not to query/expose entire table
                sysHubActionTypeDefGr.addEncodedQuery(this.scRecordsEncodedQuery);
                var conditionName = "",
                    conditionDescription = "",
                    id = "";

                if (sysHubActionTypeDefGr.get(actionType)) {
                    conditionName = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getDisplayValue();
                    conditionDescription = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getDisplayValue("description");
                    id = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getValue("sys_id");
                }
                existingConditionsOfPolicyIds.push(id);
                resp.conditions_for_ui.push({
                    "policy_condition_sysId": policyConditionSysId,
                    "id": id,
                    "model_id": id,
                    "label": conditionName,
                    "is_check_box_checked": !(value && value.length),
                    "column_name": attrName.toString(),
                    "isGlideList": actionInputObj.internal_type == "glide_list",
                    "source_table": "sn_vsc_security_policy_condition",
                    "check_box_label": "Any " + actionInputObj.getDisplayValue("label").toLowerCase(),
                    "condition_name": conditionName,
                    "condition_description": conditionDescription,
                    "condition_label": actionInputObj.getDisplayValue("label"),
                    "typeaheadSourceTable": tableName,
                    "listData": this.getListData(tableName, actionInputObj.getValue("reference_qual"), attrName.toString(), "sn_vsc_security_policy_condition"),
                    "displayOff": false,
                    "selected_value": value,
                    "currentElementId": gs.generateGUID()
                });
            }
        }
        resp.existingConditionsOfPolicyIds = existingConditionsOfPolicyIds;
        return resp;
    },

    // Functions "getEligiblePolicyConditions" and "getEligiblePolicyNotifications" will eventually be merged into common utility in next release
    getEligiblePolicyConditions: function(policyID) {
        var resp = {
            "conditions": []
        };

        // If the role is not admin/sn_vsc.security_center_viewer, we should restrict querying tables
        if (!gs.hasRole(this.constants.SECURITY_CENTER_VIEWER_ROLE)) {
            return resp;
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY);
        if (gr.get(policyID)) {
            var triggerType = gr.getValue("trigger");
            var sysHubActionRestrictionGr = new GlideRecord("sn_vsc_hub_action_restriction");
            var q1 = sysHubActionRestrictionGr.addQuery("sc_event_types", "LIKE", triggerType);
            q1.addOrCondition("sc_event_types", null);
            sysHubActionRestrictionGr.addQuery("hub_action.category", this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY_CONDITIONS_HUB_CATEGORY);
            sysHubActionRestrictionGr.query();
            // Get the action definition for the related qualifying condition one by one
            while (sysHubActionRestrictionGr.next()) {
                var hubActionSysId = sysHubActionRestrictionGr.getValue("hub_action");
                var additionalQuery = "sys_id=" + hubActionSysId;
                var sysHubActionTypeDefGr = new GlideRecord("sys_hub_action_type_definition");
                // Limiting only to SC related records so not to query/expose entire table
                sysHubActionTypeDefGr.addEncodedQuery(this.scRecordsEncodedQuery);
                if (sysHubActionTypeDefGr.get(hubActionSysId)) {
                    var conditionName = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getDisplayValue(),
                        conditionDescription = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getDisplayValue("description");
                    var tableName = "",
                        attrName = "";
                    additionalQuery = "model_id=" + sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getValue("sys_id");
                    var actionInputObj = new GlideRecord("sys_hub_action_input");
                    // Limiting only to SC related records so not to query/expose entire table
                    actionInputObj.addEncodedQuery(this.scRecordsEncodedQuery);
                    if (actionInputObj.get("model_id", sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getValue("sys_id"))) {
                        tableName = actionInputObj.getValue("reference");
                        attrName = actionInputObj.element;
                    }

                    // Create the list of qualifying conditions finally for the dropdown on the UI
                    resp["conditions"].push({
                        "id": actionInputObj.getValue("model_id"),
                        "model_id": actionInputObj.getValue("model_id"),
                        "column_name": attrName.toString(),
                        "isGlideList": actionInputObj.internal_type == "glide_list",
                        "source_table": "sn_vsc_security_policy_condition",
                        "label": conditionName,
                        "is_check_box_checked": false,
                        "check_box_label": gs.getMessage("Any {0}", actionInputObj.getDisplayValue("label").toLowerCase()),
                        "condition_name": conditionName,
                        "condition_description": conditionDescription,
                        "condition_label": actionInputObj.getDisplayValue("label"),
                        "typeaheadSourceTable": tableName,
                        "listData": this.getListData(tableName, actionInputObj.getValue("reference_qual"), attrName.toString(), "sn_vsc_security_policy_condition"),
                        "displayOff": true,
                        "currentElementId": gs.generateGUID()
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        return resp;
    },

    getExistingPolicyNotifications: function(policyID) {
        var resp = {
            "data": [],
            "existingIds": []
        };

        // If the role is not admin/sn_vsc.security_center_viewer, we should restrict querying tables
        if (!gs.hasRole(this.constants.SECURITY_CENTER_VIEWER_ROLE)) {
            return resp;
        }

        // Determine whether the policy is OOB. If yes, then these existing notifications are not allowed to be removed from the UI by the user. But values can be changed.
        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY);
        var policyIsOOB = false;
        if (gr.get(policyID) && gr.getValue("policy_type") == "system") {
            policyIsOOB = true;
        }

        // Get all the records for the policy in a provided sourceTable
        gr = new GlideRecord(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY_ACTION);
        gr.addQuery("policy", policyID);
        gr.query();
        // Get all the action inputs one by one for the policy notification(s)
        var existingIds = [];
        while (gr.next()) {
            var attributes = gr.action_attributes;
            var actionType = gr.getValue("action_type");
            var actionInputObj = new GlideRecord("sys_hub_action_input");
            // Limiting only to SC related records so not to query/expose entire table
            actionInputObj.addEncodedQuery(this.scRecordsEncodedQuery);
            actionInputObj.addQuery("model_id", "LIKE", actionType);
            actionInputObj.query();
            var output = [];
            var model_id = "";
            var actionName = "",
                actionDescription = "";
            while (actionInputObj.next()) {
                var attrName = actionInputObj.element;
                var value = attributes[attrName].toString();
                var tableName = actionInputObj.getValue("reference");
                if (tableName) {
                    var sysIds = value.split(",");
                    value = this.createSelectedValuesConfig(tableName, sysIds, attrName.toString(), "sn_vsc_security_policy_action");
                }

                var sysHubActionTypeDefGr = new GlideRecord("sys_hub_action_type_definition");
                // Limiting only to SC related records so not to query/expose entire table
                sysHubActionTypeDefGr.addEncodedQuery(this.scRecordsEncodedQuery);
                var id = "";

                // Get the name and description
                if (sysHubActionTypeDefGr.get(actionType)) {
                    actionName = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getDisplayValue();
                    actionDescription = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getDisplayValue("description");
                    id = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getValue("sys_id");
                }
                var query = tableName == 'sysevent_email_action' ? "collection=sn_vsc_security_policy_notification^ORtemplate.collection=sn_vsc_security_policy_notification" : null;
                output.push({
                    "id": actionInputObj.getValue("sys_id"),
                    "model_id": actionInputObj.getValue("model_id"),
                    "label": actionName,
                    "labelValue": actionInputObj.getDisplayValue("label"),
                    "typeaheadSourceTable": tableName,
                    "listData": this.getListData(tableName, query, attrName.toString(), "sn_vsc_security_policy_action"),
                    "displayOff": false,
                    "selected_value": value,
                    "policy_action_sysId": gr.getValue("sys_id"),
                    "column_name": attrName.toString(),
                    "isGlideList": actionInputObj.internal_type == "glide_list",
                    "source_table": "sn_vsc_security_policy_action",
                    "currentElementId": gs.generateGUID()
                });
                model_id = actionInputObj.getValue("model_id");
            }

            var finalObj = {
                "model_id": model_id,
                "name": actionName,
                "description": actionDescription,
                "displayOff": false,
                "label": actionName,
                "id": model_id,
                "isCustomNotification": gr.getValue("policy_type") == "custom",
                "data": output,
                "policy_action_sysId": gr.getValue("sys_id")
            };
            resp.data.push(finalObj);
            existingIds.push(model_id);
        }
        resp.existingIds = existingIds;
        return resp;
    },

    getEligiblePolicyNotifications: function(policyID) {
        var resp = {
            "data": []
        };

        // If the role is not admin/sn_vsc.security_center_viewer, we should restrict querying tables
        if (!gs.hasRole(this.constants.SECURITY_CENTER_VIEWER_ROLE)) {
            return resp;
        }

        var gr = new GlideRecord(this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY);
        if (gr.get(policyID)) {
            var triggerType = gr.getValue("trigger");
            var sysHubActionRestrictionGr = new GlideRecord("sn_vsc_hub_action_restriction");
            var q1 = sysHubActionRestrictionGr.addQuery("sc_event_types", "LIKE", triggerType);
            q1.addOrCondition("sc_event_types", null);
            sysHubActionRestrictionGr.addQuery("hub_action.category", this.constants.SECURITY_POLICY_NOTIFICATIONS_HUB_CATEGORY);
            sysHubActionRestrictionGr.query();
            // Get the action definition for the related qualifying notification one by one
            while (sysHubActionRestrictionGr.next()) {
                var hubActionSysId = sysHubActionRestrictionGr.getValue("hub_action");
                var addtionalQuery = "sys_id=" + hubActionSysId;

                var sysHubActionTypeDefGr = new GlideRecord("sys_hub_action_type_definition");
                // Limiting only to SC related records so not to query/expose entire table
                sysHubActionRestrictionGr.addEncodedQuery(this.scRecordsEncodedQuery);

                if (sysHubActionTypeDefGr.get(hubActionSysId)) {
                    var actionName = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getDisplayValue(),
                        actionDescription = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getDisplayValue("description");
                    var tableName = "",
                        attrName = "";
                    var actionType = sysHubActionTypeDefGr.getValue("sys_id");
                    additionalQuery = "model_id=" + actionType;
                    // Limiting only to SC related records so not to query/expose entire table
                    var actionInputObj = new GlideRecord("sys_hub_action_input");
                    // Limiting only to SC related records so not to query/expose entire table
                    actionInputObj.addEncodedQuery(this.scRecordsEncodedQuery);
                    actionInputObj.addQuery("model_id", "LIKE", actionType);
                    actionInputObj.query();
                    var output = [];
                    var model_id = "";
                    while (actionInputObj.next()) {
                        tableName = actionInputObj.getValue("reference");
                        attrName = actionInputObj.element.toString();
                        var query = tableName == 'sysevent_email_action' ? "collection=sn_vsc_security_policy_notification^ORtemplate.collection=sn_vsc_security_policy_notification" : null;
                        output.push({
                            "id": actionInputObj.getValue("sys_id"),
                            "model_id": actionInputObj.getValue("model_id"),
                            "column_name": attrName,
                            "isGlideList": actionInputObj.internal_type == "glide_list",
                            "source_table": "sn_vsc_security_policy_action",
                            "labelValue": actionInputObj.getDisplayValue("label"),
                            "typeaheadSourceTable": tableName,
                            "listData": this.getListData(tableName, query, attrName, "sn_vsc_security_policy_action"),
                            "displayOff": true,
                            "currentElementId": gs.generateGUID()
                        });
                        model_id = actionInputObj.getValue("model_id");
                    }
                    var finalObj = {
                        "model_id": model_id,
                        "name": actionName,
                        "description": actionDescription,
                        "displayOff": true,
                        "label": actionName,
                        "id": model_id,
                        "isCustomNotification": true,
                        "data": output,
                        "policy_action_sysId": null
                    };
                    resp.data.push(finalObj);
                }
            }
        }
        return resp;
    },

	/**
	 * Prepare the entire list data for the typeahead / dropdown component, for admin role only
	 * "columnName" and "tableToUpdate" are required for when we change the values on the UI. And the only way to capture for multi params is to have it in there . So the default available component's event
	 *  handler can take it
	 */
    getListData: function(tableName, encodedQuery, columnName, tableToUpdate) {
        var data = [];
        if (gs.hasRole(this.constants.ADMIN_ROLE)) {
            var gr = new GlideRecordSecure(tableName);
            gr.setLimit(this.defaultRecordsCountToFetch);
            gr.orderBy(gr.getDisplayName());
            if (encodedQuery) {
                gr.addEncodedQuery(encodedQuery);
            }
            gr.query();
            while (gr.next()) {
                data.push({
                    "id": gr.getValue("sys_id"),
                    "label": gr.getDisplayValue(),
                    "column": columnName,
                    "tableToUpdate": tableToUpdate
                });
            }
        }
        return data;
    },

    createSelectedValuesConfig: function(table, sysIds, columnName, tableToUpdate) {
        var res = [];
        // Create id and label pairs for the typeahead component
        for (var i = 0; i < sysIds.length; i++) {
            var gr = new GlideRecord(table);
            var sysId = sysIds[i];
            if (gr.get(sysId)) {
                res.push({
                    "id": sysId,
                    "label": gr.getDisplayValue(),
                    "column": columnName,
                    "tableToUpdate": tableToUpdate
                });
            }
        }
        return res;
    },
    type: 'SCSecurityPolicyUtil'
};]]></script>
